observed.camera: Landscape, eye-level to slightly elevated three-quarter view from the station platform; canopy and platform edges recede toward a center-right distance, with tracks opening toward the right foreground.
observed.character_facing: Traveler is shown in right-facing profile/three-quarter profile, looking toward the train.
layer_relationships: Traveler and backpack occupy the near platform foreground; backpack sits behind the traveler torso.
Traveler's gripping hand and suitcase handle overlap in the foreground.
Train occupies the midground and covers portions of the rails behind it.
Station structure, hills, and sky are background; canopy beams frame the upper-left and upper-center.
crop_and_occlusion: Traveler's lower body reaches and is cropped by the bottom image edge; feet and exact ground-contact point are not visible.
Suitcase continues beyond the bottom image edge; its complete lower edge and wheel contacts are not visible.
Background pixels behind traveler, backpack, suitcase, and train are hidden in the master.

inferred.train_approach_direction: Toward the viewer along the visible rails, generally toward the lower-right foreground; the master is a still image, so movement is inferred rather than observed.
inferred.traveler_ground_contact: A platform contact line below the bottom crop is required for a full-body walking sprite; its exact position cannot be measured from this image.
inferred.pose_and_motion: Walking limbs, hidden lower-body anatomy, head-turn frames, and intermediate train positions are not present in the still and must be authored consistently with the visible design.
